paite: Upa in, deihtak Gaias thutak a ka it kiang ah;
heading: Chibai Bukna
english: The elder to Gaius the beloved, whom I love in truth.

paite: deihtak, na kha in vualzawlna amuh bang in, bangkim a vualzawlna na muh leh na damtheihna ding in ka thum zel hi.
english: Beloved, I pray that you may prosper in all things and be healthy, even as your soul prospers.

paite: Unaute ahong pai un, thutak a na hindan leh na muanhuaidan ahon theihpih ziak un ka kipak mahmah hi.
english: For I rejoiced greatly when brothers came and testified about your truth, even as you walk in truth.

paite: Ka tate thutak ah a-om uh chih ka zak kan a kipahna thupizaw ka nei kei hi.
english: I have no greater joy than this: to hear about my children walking in truth.

paite: Deihtak unaute mikhual himah le uh, atung ua na hih peuh ah muanhuaitak in na hih zel a;
heading: Gaias Thilphalna
english: Beloved, you do a faithful work in whatever you accomplish for those who are brothers and strangers.

paite: huaite'n saptuamte ma ah na itna atheipihta uhi; amau tuh azinna ua Pathian mite hihtuak him a na khakkhiakleh na hihhoih ding hi.
english: They have testified about your love before the assembly. You will do well to send them forward on their journey in a way worthy of God,

paite: Amau Khrist min a azinna uah Zentelte kiang a kipan bangmah la lou in apawt zel ngal ua.
english: because for the sake of the Name they went out, taking nothing from the Gentiles.

paite: Huchi in thutak a seppihte i hihtheihna ding in huchibang mite, eite'n i kipahpih ding mah ahi.
english: We therefore ought to receive such, that we may be fellow workers for the truth.

paite: Saptuamte kiang ah thu neukha zaw ka gelhta; himahleh Diotrephes, alak ua tungnun ut nakpa'n akipahpih kei hi.
heading: Diotrephes
english: I wrote to the assembly, but Diotrephes, who loves to be first among them, doesn’t accept what we say.

paite: Huaiziak in ka hong paileh athilhihte ka pholhkhe ding a, i tung ua thu dikloupi agen a akamtamdan ka theikhesak ding hi. Huan huai leng hun asa kei a, amah ngei in unaute akipahpih kei a, akipahpih nuamte leng khou in saptuamte lak a kipan adelhkhia hi.
english: Therefore, if I come, I will call attention to his deeds which he does, unjustly accusing us with wicked words. Not content with this, he doesn’t receive the brothers himself, and those who would, he forbids and throws out of the assembly.

paite: Deihtak, giloumi omdan zui ke'n, ahoih zui zaw in. Kuapeuh thil hoih hihmi tuh Pathian a pan ahi; thil gilou hihmi in Pathian amu ngei kei hi.
english: Beloved, don’t imitate that which is evil, but that which is good. He who does good is of God. He who does evil hasn’t seen God.

paite: Demetrias in mi tengteng phat aloh a, thutak a phat nangawn aloh behlap hi; eite'n leng i phat ua, hiai phatna adik ahi chih na thei hi.
heading: Demetrias
english: Demetrius has the testimony of all, and of the truth itself; yes, we also testify, and you know that our testimony is true.

paite: Na kiang ah thu tampi gelh ding ka nei, himahleh laitui leh laipuan a gelh ka ut kei hi.
heading: Mangpha Khakna
english: I had many things to write to you, but I am unwilling to write to you with ink and pen;

paite: Sawt lou nung chiang in hon muh ka lamen hi, huchi in kimaituah in i kihou ding.
english: but I hope to see you soon. Then we will speak face to face. Peace be to you. The friends greet you. Greet the friends by name.

paite: Khamuanna na tung ah om hen. I lawmte'n chibai ahon buk uhi. Amin uh lou chiat in lawmte chibai hon buksak in.
